question: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 11 and 792, respectively. If one number is 88, then find the other number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of two numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM.

Other Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

Other Number = (11 × 792) ÷ 88

Other Number = 792 ÷ 8 = 99

**∴ The correct answer is 99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 11

LCM = 792

First number (N₁) = 88

**Formula Used:**

N₁ × N₂ = HCF × LCM

**Calculations:**

⇒ 88 × N₂ = 11 × 792

⇒ N₂ = (11 × 792) ÷ 88

⇒ N₂ = 792 ÷ 8

⇒ N₂ = 99

**∴ The correct answer is 99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Property of HCF and LCM for Two Numbers

The product of the Highest Common Factor (HCF) and the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of two numbers is exactly equal to the product of the numbers themselves. Note that this formula holds true only for a pair of two numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is exactly 1. In such cases, their LCM is directly calculated as the product of the two numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of numerators) ÷ (LCM of denominators)
LCM of fractions = (LCM of numerators) ÷ (HCF of denominators)
